task1_probes: The four concepts become decodable at clearly different depths: part of speech first (around layer 3), then sentiment (around layer 8), named entity type (around layer 13 to 14), and statement truthfulness last (around layer 19).
task2_heads: Three heads matter: layer 9 head 6, layer 9 head 9 and layer 10 head 0; ablating any of the other 141 heads barely changes the loss.
task3_attribution: Integrated gradients matches ablation best on all three models (rank correlation about 0.8 to 0.9), clearly ahead of the next best method, attribution patching (about 0.6).
